text.en: Clients describe how noticeably their dogs' confidence and happiness improve after joining the group walks. Owners of energetic puppies and rescue dogs note that pets wait eagerly at the window for collection, enjoy exciting countryside paths together, and return home relaxed and well exercised after every outing.

Reviewers describe Natasha and her fellow walkers as exceptionally dedicated, patient, and trustworthy. Pet parents appreciate that the team handles dogs with gentle positive reinforcement, accommodates individual temperaments seamlessly, and treats each pet with genuine warmth and personal affection.

Owners who booked puppy training sessions and structured group walks observe significant behavioural improvements in their dogs. Clients report that reactive or overexcited pets learn to focus, walk calmly on leash, and socialise politely with unfamiliar dogs thanks to structured coaching sessions.

q.en: Which areas are covered for dog walking?

a.en: Happy Little Paws provides weekday group walks across South London, including Streatham Hill, Herne Hill, and Tulse Hill.

q.en: Are updates and photos sent during walks?

a.en: Yes, pet parents consistently praise the daily photos, videos, and detailed message updates sent after each group outing.

q.en: Is positive reinforcement used during training?

a.en: Yes, the team uses gentle reward-based training techniques to build puppy confidence and manage leash manners effectively.
